# World Cup 2026: Algeria face Ramy Bensebaini fitness worry before opener
[...]
Algeria are facing uncertainty over the fitness of key defender Ramy Bensebaini just hours before the start of the 2026 World Cup in North America, with the Borussia Dortmund player still not fully recovered from injury.
[...]
However, concern has grown after a foot injury ruled him out of Borussia Dortmund’s final three Bundesliga matches of the season. That setback also cast doubt over his readiness for international duty heading into the tournament.
[...]
Algeria head coach Vladimir Petkovic ultimately opted to include him in the World Cup squad despite the fitness concerns, reflecting his trust in the defender’s ability to recover in time.
[...]
There had been expectations that Bensebaini would feature in pre-tournament warm-up matches against the Netherlands and Bolivia, but he remained on the bench for both fixtures.
[...]
His continued absence from match action has now raised questions over his readiness for Algeria’s opening Group match against Argentina. While he remains part of the squad, he is still believed to be in a recovery phase and not yet operating at full intensity.
[...]
The Algerian medical staff are working to manage his rehabilitation carefully, with hopes that he can gradually return to full fitness as the tournament progresses. His availability could prove crucial given his experience at major international competitions.
[...]
For now, Algeria must prepare for their World Cup campaign with uncertainty surrounding one of their most important defenders, as they await clearer signs of Bensebaini’s recovery in the coming days.

# 2026 World Cup: Careful Algeria approach keeps Hicham Boudaoui out of Rotterdam friendly
[...]
Hicham Boudaoui will remain in Algiers and miss Algeria’s upcoming friendly against the Netherlands after the national team’s coaching and medical staff decided not to include him in the squad travelling to Rotterdam.
[...]
The midfielder has been rested as he continues his recovery process following a collision sustained during the play-off match against AS Saint-Étienne, with Algeria opting for a cautious approach ahead of the 2026 World Cup.
[...]
His absence means he will not take part in one of Algeria’s most significant preparatory fixtures before the tournament, as Vladimir Petkovic’s side prepares to face the Netherlands in Rotterdam.
[...]
The player remains under concussion protocol after suffering a collision during the play-off encounter against AS Saint-Étienne.
[...]
While he continues to recover, medical assessments determined that he was not yet ready to resume competitive action.
[...]

highlights:
# Boudawi Announces Readiness and Strengthens Algeria's Ranks Before Bolivia Friendly and Argentina Clash
[...]
Sunday 07-06-2026
[...]
The Algerian national team regained the services of its midfielder, Hicham Boudawi, after he participated normally in the morning training session today, Sunday, following his full recovery from the injury he had been suffering from in the past period, thus putting an end to doubts about his readiness.Hicham Boudawi had joined the 'Desert Warriors' camp suffering from an injury to the face and head, which he sustained on May 26 during his club Nice's match against Saint-Étienne in the first leg of the relegation play-off in the French Ligue 1.This injury caused him to miss the second leg match held on May 29, and also led coach Vladimir Petković to exempt him from traveling to Rotterdam, where the Algerian national team played a friendly against the Netherlands, which ended with a victory for the 'Desert Warriors' last Wednesday.In a positive development, Boudawi appeared on Sunday morning in the national team's camp in Kansas City, USA, where he participated in group training normally without any restrictions, confirming his complete recovery and regaining his physical fitness.This development gives the technical staff great relief before the anticipated friendly this Wednesday against Bolivia, in a final test one week before the Algerian national team's official first appearance in the World Cup against Argentina.

results.title: Bentaleb back for Algeria as World Cup squad named - CNA

ALGIERS, May 31 : Algeria handed a recall to midfielder Nabil Bentaleb and included him in their squad for the World Cup as coach Vladimir Petkovic on Sunday unveiled his selection for the tournament in Canada, Mexico, and the United States.
[...]
Bentaleb, 31, has not played for the team since last October but has been recalled to a squad that also sees the return of key attackers Houssem Aouar and Amine Gouiri, who missed the Africa Cup of Nations finals in Morocco at the turn of the year because of injury.

The Desert Foxes make a fifth tournament appearance, following 1982, 1986, 2010 and 2014. Their deepest run came in Brazil 12 years ago. Captain Riyad Mahrez leads the side at 35, with 113 caps and 38 goals to his name.

The Al-Ahli winger has carried Algeria’s hopes through a decade of international football. Veteran defender Aïssa Mandi anchors the back line as the country’s most-capped player on 116 appearances. Mohamed Amoura, the VfL Wolfsburg striker, finished as Algeria’s top scorer in qualifying with 10 goals in eight matches.

Bayer Leverkusen’s Ibrahim Maza represents the next generation as one of Algerian football’s brightest young talents. The most eye-catching call concerns Luca Zidane, the Granada goalkeeper and son of French legend Zinedine. The shot-stopper recovered from a double chin and jaw fracture to make the squad.
